segments.name: Entertainment and dining
segments.description: Operates high-volume entertainment and dining venues in North America for adults and families, combining arcade games, sports viewing, food and beverage.
segments.evidence: The Company operates its business as one reportable operating segment with two reporting units based on its major brands, Dave & Buster's and Main Event.

revenueModel.text: Guests pay for entertainment and game play credits, food, and beverages at the company's stores.
revenueModel.evidence: Each store offers a full menu of entrées and appetizers, a complete selection of alcoholic and non-alcoholic beverages, and an extensive assortment of entertainment attractions centered around playing games and watching live sports and other televised events.
